examples.title: Status label
examples.description: Badge is a passive label. Its default variant and size stay unchanged.

examples.title: All variants
examples.description: All ten existing variant names remain accepted, including primary, secondary and destructive.

examples.title: All sizes
examples.description: Small, default and large sizes retain 22, 26 and 30px heights.

examples.title: Review approval
examples.description: A separate button changes the review status. The passive badge settles when its label and icon change.

examples.title: Icons and dot
examples.description: leftIcon, rightIcon and dot are decorative. Keep the meaning in the readable label.

examples.title: As a link
examples.description: asChild applies the badge styles and native attributes to one child. Compose icon content in that child yourself.
